output.title: Statement of Work: Harbor Pilates booking system build
output.body_markdown:
# Statement of Work

This Statement of Work ("SOW") is entered into under the Master Services Agreement between Sarga Haus ("Studio") and Harbor Pilates Studio LLC ("Client"), dated {{MSA_DATE}}.

## 1. Services
The Studio will design and build the booking system described in the approved proposal titled "Harbor Pilates: booking system build": public schedule, booking and payment flow, waitlist automation, instructor admin, and morning operations summary.

## 2. Timeline
Five (5) weeks from the Start Date. The Start Date is the first business day after both signature and the initial payment are received. No work begins before both.

## 3. Fees and payment
Fixed fee of $14,000 USD. Fifty percent (7,000) due on signing; fifty percent (7,000) due at delivery. No hourly billing. Third-party costs (hosting, SMS) are passed through at cost with prior written approval.

## 4. Scope changes
Changes are agreed in a written change memo signed by both parties before work on the change begins.

## 5. Client responsibilities
Access items listed in the project brief delivered within the first week; one decision-maker with 48 hour approval turnaround.

## 6. Acceptance
Deliverables are accepted when the launch checklist is approved by the Client or after seven (7) days in production without written objection, whichever comes first.

## 7. Ownership
On full payment, all work product transfers to the Client: repository, database, and domains run under Client accounts.

Signed:

Studio: {{STUDIO_SIGNATORY}}    Date: {{DATE}}

Client: {{CLIENT_SIGNATORY}}    Date: {{DATE}}
